items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: He said, "You got anything around that you would like to record?"

ctx.x: Kind of an offshoot of the New Jersey Jazz Society.

Right. They asked me -- oh, Bill Borden is a member of it, and they mentioned in New Jersey Jazz who their guests are and I went over there with my brother and Bill saw us and so he came up and he says, "I just come up to see you. I wondered what happened to you." Well, nothing much. He said, "You got anything around that you would like to record?" and I guess he thought I was a real hot jazz man.
"Anything of Beiderbecke's?" Well, I said, "I have the piano pieces," but that's recorded in 1904, that took me a little while to do --
